text:
Google has run two core updates and three spam updates so far this year.

Spam updates go after shortcuts. Fake reviews, stuffed business names, junk pages.

Keep your profile honest and your website useful. When the shortcut crowd drops off the map, you're still standing.

Your competitor put "Emergency Plumber 24/7 Blocked Drains" in his Google business name and sits above you on the map.

Don't copy him. Google says extra words in your name could get your profile suspended.

Keep the name on your van. Put the keywords in your services, categories and description.

A Fremantle cafe owner wants page one on Google by Christmas.

I tell him nobody honest can promise that.

He signs with someone who did.

(Christmas is seven weeks away. I'll check back.)

I'd rather lose the job than lie to get it.
